data.title: Starlight Park
data.about:
Starlight Park Apartments in Meydan District 11 are crafted by Amwaj Development, a distinguished real estate developer in the UAE. They are committed to enhancing living standards by building communities that focus on rich experiences, innovation, and ecological sustainability. 

The Starlight Park development consists of four blocks—A, B, C, and D—each featuring five floors topped with a rooftop swimming pool and a residents’ lounge. These buildings offer a variety of units, from 1 to 3 bedroom apartments, tailored to fit diverse needs. Residents of Starlight Park Apartments for Sale in Meydan will enjoy exclusive resort-style amenities that provide a vibrant lifestyle.

Each apartment is equipped with top-tier kitchen appliances, a built-in TV unit, and a uniquely designed wall accent in the master bedroom. Located in Starlight Park Apartment District 11 Meydan, this luxury development promotes family-centric living and provides a sophisticated retreat. It showcases four majestic buildings and features a well-designed community area at the heart of Starlight Park Meydan, highlighting Amwaj Development projects.

characteristics_module.title: Urban & Luxury Living Redefined at Starlight Park
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Developer Prestige: Crafted by Amwaj Development, renowned for enhancing living standards through innovative and sustainable community projects.
  • Variety of Units: Offers 1 to 3 bedroom apartments across four blocks (A, B, C, D), each tailored to diverse needs and topped with exclusive amenities.
  • Luxury Amenities: Includes rooftop swimming pools, fitness and boxing studios, a rooftop cinema, yoga and paddle tennis facilities, kids' areas, an elevated lobby lounge, 24/7 security, and EV charging stations.
  • Prime Location: Situated in the heart of Meydan District 11, Dubai, near major landmarks like Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Mall.
  • Family-Centric Living: Promotes a family-oriented lifestyle with well-designed community areas and resort-style living.
  • Sophisticated Interiors: Each apartment features top-tier kitchen appliances, a built-in TV unit, and a uniquely designed wall accent in the master bedroom.
  • Accessible Pricing and Payment Plan: Starting from AED 988K with a 60/40 payment plan, completion slated for Q2 2026.
  • Visionary Urban Development: Part of a development that enhances Dubai’s international stature under the visionary leadership of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.
